task_note: South Asia feasibility recipe for the South_Asia_AMR_Wide_Matrix workbook. Use only South Asian rows before this run; it is not India-specific. Uses reported S/R labels and excludes intermediate labels for the binary endpoint. At least three of six predictor-drug categories are required. The workbook mixes CLSI and EUCAST results and provides no standard editions or test method details, so this is exploratory only.
